Faq.title: Short answers that reduce friction before the assessment.

items.question: Do you only work with large companies?
items.answer: No. We start by helping founders, SMBs and growth-stage teams that want to implement AI with clarity and discipline.

items.question: Do I need advanced tools before we start?
items.answer: No. We evaluate your current stack and recommend the simplest effective combination for your operation.

items.question: Do you implement or just advise?
items.answer: Both: assessment, strategy, training and hands-on implementation of workflows and AI assets.

items.question: What happens after the assessment?
items.answer: You receive an initial roadmap recommendation and the most suitable plan for your business, plus the option to schedule a discovery call.
